free_parameters.name: n_col
free_parameters.why: matches the single 32x32 block so ordered_pricing contains exactly one candidate block

free_parameters.name: dtype

free_parameters.name: price_element
free_parameters.why: cover_sizes[(1,1)] from the witness trigger; the element-wise price the block price is compared with

free_parameters.name: price_block
free_parameters.why: cost of one 32x32 block; with filled=500 the derived ordered_pricing[0][0] is exactly 2 as in the witness trigger, and with filled=1000 it is exactly 1 as in the contrast
